newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway 12-month T-bill gets high yield of 5.33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norway 12-month T-bill gets high yield of 5.33 pct.

text.p: Norway's Central Bank said on Monday a new 12-month treasury bill of 4.5 billion crowns produced the highest yield of 5.33 percent.
The lowest yield was 5.29 percent and the weighted average 5.32 percent.
Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 78.7 percent allotment, the bank said in a statement.
The bill, SS44, of which 500 million crowns were reserved for the bank, was announced last Thursday. It has a nominal interest of 5.20 percent.
The registration number of the T-bill is 200034.2.
